newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian share index rides higher on oil firms.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian share index rides higher on oil firms.

text.p: Nigeria's share index closed higher on the back of gains by oil marketing companies in busy Wednesday trading, dealers said.
The all-share index closed at 6586.89 from 6,570.51 on Tuesday.
African Petroleum closed 83 kobo higher at 33.65 naira.
Mobil was 50 kobo higher at 40.00 naira, National Oil 50 kobo higher at 34.70 naira and Unipetrol 50 kobo higher at 42.50.
Nestle Foods rose 30 kobo to 34.30 naira, the same margin as West African Portland Cement which closed at 34.80 naira.
Nigerian Breweries and Guinness both fell 20 kobo to 7.60 naira and 11.60 naira, respectively.
Dunlop fell 15 kobo to 11.15 naira while Cadbury and Ashaka Cement ended 10 kobo down, at 26.55 naira and 18.90 naira respectively.
Banks were mixed. NAL Merchant Bank rose 20 kobo to 5.40 naira, Union Bank dropped 10 kobo to 7.80 naira.
